title: Autoregressive Models Rival Diffusion Models at ANY-ORDER Generation

layout.note: A staircase from bottom-left to top-right: the input strip and Embedding sit bottom-left, the grey query strip bottom-right, one big rounded frame in the middle holds two equal mask grids side by side split by a dashed line, and the output and target strips sit top-right.

lesson: Give every token group one colour and keep it on the tokens, the states, the group braces and the outline of its block in the mask grids, so a pair of small grids explains a masking rule without a key. Draw the two variants as equal grids side by side so only the changed cells differ.
